name: Proxmox_VE_Nodes
description: CPU, memory, uptime and availability for every node in a Proxmox VE cluster, collected cluster-wide in a single API call.
technicalNotes:
BatchScript: one /cluster/resources?type=node call per interval regardless of cluster size.

Instance IDs are the Proxmox resource id (node/<name>). Load average, swap and root filesystem are not available from this endpoint and are collected by Proxmox VE Node Detail.

datapoints.name: Status
datapoints.alertBody:
Proxmox node ##INSTANCE## is offline.

This started at ##START##, ##DURATION## ago.

datapoints.name: CPUUsagePercent
datapoints.alertBody:
Proxmox node ##INSTANCE## is at ##VALUE##% CPU. Its guests are competing for CPU time; consider migrating some to a less busy node.

This started at ##START##, ##DURATION## ago.

datapoints.name: CPUCount
datapoints.description: Logical CPUs available to the node.

datapoints.name: MemoryUsagePercent
datapoints.alertBody:
Proxmox node ##INSTANCE## is using ##VALUE##% of its memory. Close to the limit the host starts swapping or killing processes, guests included.

This started at ##START##, ##DURATION## ago.
